Johnson & Johnson's gross margin in fiscal Q2 2023 was about 69.97%, based on the figures restated after the Kenvue separation (as shown in the Q2 2024 10-Q comparatives). These figures are from memory rather than a filing in front of me, so treat this as a best estimate.

- Sales to customers: $21,519 million
- Cost of products sold: $6,462 million
- Gross profit: $15,057 million, so 15,057 / 21,519 ≈ 69.97%

As originally reported, with Kenvue still consolidated (sales $25,530 million, cost of products sold $8,212 million), the margin would have been about 67.8%.
